name: Ijuuin Masato
source:
Bartender Hanny who working at the local bar, "Haniwa Roman."
Of course, he's friendly to humans.
He's always making "hanny hanny shaka shaka" sound while making delicious cocktails.
Surprisingly, has a cool masculine side too?
